strings.Traditional Chinese and English are the: IsiShayina Sendabuko nesiNgisi yikho okuqukethwe okuyinhloko okuphelele. Isixhumi esibonakalayo sifika nezichazamazwi ezakhelwe ngaphakathi zezilimi ezingu-77 ezengeziwe futhi silandela ulimi lwesiphequluli sakho. Umbhalo wezifundo uhunyushwa kudivayisi yakho eziphequluli ezikusekelayo (njenge-Chrome); uma kungenjalo, uhlala ngesiNgisi. Ukukhetha kwakho ulimi kugcinwa kuwo wonke amakhasi.
